python3 - <<'PY'
BASE = '35530bfb5774ccbda3dddfcd41764764ad86f3ea'
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET
paths = [
    'src/Hexalith.Parties.Projections/Handlers/PartyIndexSdkProjectionHandler.cs',
    'src/Hexalith.Parties.Projections/Models/PartyIndexSdkReadModel.cs',
]
count = 0
for name in paths:
    current = Path(name).read_text()
    original = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', BASE + ':' + name], text=True)
    def without_docs(text):
        return '\n'.join(line for line in text.splitlines() if not line.lstrip().startswith('///'))
    assert without_docs(original) == without_docs(current), name
    for block in re.findall(r'(?:^\s*///[^\n]*\n)+', current, re.M):
        xml = '\n'.join(re.sub(r'^\s*/// ?', '', line) for line in block.splitlines())
        ET.fromstring('<doc>' + xml + '</doc>')
        count += 1
page = Path('docs/data-models.md')
section = page.read_text().split('### Party index projection version\n', 1)[1].split('### Supporting model types', 1)[0]
for target in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)', section):
    assert (page.parent / target.split('#')[0]).exists(), target
assert all(line.rstrip() == line for line in section.splitlines())
print(f'PASS: {count} XML blocks parse; Markdown link resolves; C# changes are documentation only; no new trailing whitespace')
PY
